svg.title: Can a traffic model improve a night journey?
svg.desc: Model: Traffic lights are adjusted to reduce average delays.. Consult: A night worker shows which journey has gone unmeasured.. Act: A budget and a decision are needed to change the timetable.

g.text: Can a traffic model improve a night journey?
Traffic lights are adjusted to reduce average delays.
A night worker shows which journey has gone unmeasured.
A budget and a decision are needed to change the timetable.
